summary: In the Ansible community package, deprecations are up to collection maintainers; it is recommended a feature deprecated in one major is kept for a year or until at least the next major, and semantic versioning prevents removal within a major.
questions: How long will a deprecated collection feature stay in the Ansible package?
Can a deprecated module option be removed in a minor Ansible release?
If something is deprecated in Ansible 3.1.0, when can it be removed?

answer_card.title: Deprecation in the community package
answer_card.answer_md:
It depends on each collection's maintainers. Recommended practice: deprecate in one Ansible major and keep it for a year or at least until the next major. For example, deprecated in 3.1.0 means removed no earlier than 4.0.0 (ideally 5.0.0).

Because collections use semantic versioning and can't change major version within an Ansible major, removal shouldn't happen before the next major package release, but this is not guaranteed.
